title: Auto Crop golden-set label
description: One label file per image, named <image file name>.json. Labels are made blank-quad (never from the app's suggestion). Checked by `cargo xtask check-labels` (crates/eval/src/golden.rs); a unit test keeps that code and this file in step. Beyond the schema the checker enforces: the quad is finite, simple, clockwise and convex; `negative` if and only if there are no items; the file name equals id; no duplicate ids; one label per image; the image exists and its SHA-256 still matches.

id.description: The image's file name (unique within the set); the label file is <id>.json.

image.description: The image file name inside the image directory (a plain name, no path); equal to id.

image_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the image file's bytes when it was labelled.

width.description: Width of the EXIF-oriented image the quads are normalised to.

height.description: Height of the EXIF-oriented image the quads are normalised to.

scene_id.description: Shared by images of the same base document or background; used for scene-disjoint splits. Defaults to the file name (every image its own scene); give near-duplicates one shared value.

tier.description: Optional. `cargo xtask golden lock` (splits.lock.json) is the authority on which split an image is in.

orientation_quarter_turns.description: Clockwise quarter turns needed to make the content upright (derived by the labeller from the first quad's top edge).

items.description: One entry per document or photo. Empty for no-document negatives (tag `negative`).

quad.description: Four corners TL, TR, BR, BL of the upright item (so the first edge is the top edge), clockwise on screen, normalised to the EXIF-oriented image (x / width, y / height); may lie outside the frame for partial frames. Changed from the first draft, which said source pixels: the harness manifest is normalised, so labels are too.

assisted.description: True when the labeller showed a detector suggestion for this image. Excluded from the golden evaluation and from `golden lock`.

annotator.description: Who labelled it (second annotator for the noise floor).

labelling_seconds.description: Active labelling time in seconds, summed over sessions.

labelled_at.description: UTC time of the last save (RFC 3339).
